name: A match's or a model's comments
description: ONE HOST'S THREAD: `?match=` or `?model=`, exactly one. Twenty top-level comments a page, newest first, each with all its replies oldest first -- they share its root_id, so the page is one indexed read -- with the thread's live count, whether it is locked, and a keyset cursor on (created_at, id). THE PUBLIC SEES LIVE COMMENTS ONLY: a held one is its author's (GET /v1/me/comments, which web places in the thread), and a removed or deleted one stays as a placeholder with no author and no text only while a live comment hangs beneath it. A match the public may not see answers 404 like one that does not exist, so a trial in progress has no thread in public, and a private season's match is read through /v1/private/threads (soma-user-private-threads, the same statement) by the people its season shows to. `thread_id` is null until the host's first comment. Cached under hot_cache on the community namespace: a new comment invalidates it in the same run, so the page's thirty-second re-read shows it at once.
